notes.title: Rebalances and Optimizations
notes.content:
-Rebalances
Enemy plasma boats fire rate has been drastically reduced.
Added 5 seconds of invincibility when you respawn, this prevents getting spawn killed.

-Graphic Optimizations
Voxel LODs
Vegetation LODs
Spline Mesh LODs

The Game should have smoother framerate on lower end computers now.

-CPU Optimization
Fixed a lag spike caused by the large boats destroying everything in their path.
Only 1 pirate ship will spawn during the boss battle.

notes.title: Partial Voxel Update!
notes.content:
-Full Gamepad support!!(may make some tweaks in the future)

-Voxel System
The whole island is now FULLY VOXELIZED, meaning the terrain is completely dynamic!
Added new houses that use the new voxel system.
You can use the Hammer to dig and build!
There's a Smoothness slider, a value of 0 will place a Block, a 0.25 value will give you a Stylized Block, a value of 0.75 will give you smooth terrain, be sure to combine them and have fully artistic freedom!
You can now destroy terrain and buildings with your cannons, go crazy with them!
Large vehicles like the Boss Ship and the Pirate Ships will destroy everything they collide with!
Destroying the base of a building or terrain will make it fall.

-Water System
You can now control water on the WHOLE MAP!
Equipping the Trident will allow you to control water, hold right click to move water!
Some dynamic waterfalls and geysers have been added.
The water foam has been tweaked, as well as the refraction reduced, making it more visually appealing.

-Fluid Pool
The Fluid pool now works in MULTIPLAYER!!
Added Fish you can grab and toss them around (you cant eat them yet).
Added Boats that will move around with the water.
Added Beachballs that will also move around with the water, you can also grab and toss them.
Reduced the amount of water so that players with lower end computers can also enjoy the water at decent fps.
Added a water cannon that you can activate to spray water.

-Character Movement
You can now press Left Control Ctrl to Crouch!
Crouching will make you run slightly faster and allows you to hide easier.
Crouching will also allow you to climb walls on certain circumstances.

-Characters
The Animal Cartoon Character has been slightly redesigned, he is now Orange instead of Blue, since some people didn't like the blue color, orange also contrasts a lot better with the blue environment (the ocean and the sky),
he has also gotten new Animations since the old ones were awful.
The Pirate Character has been slightly redesigned, now he has proper lower half body and shoes, as well as some more detailed texturing.
The Archer enemy has been fixed.
The Bomb enemy is now fat.


-Pirate ship
Now enemy pirate ships will spawn and they'll shoot cannon balls at you!!
Fixed some jittering issues
Fixed performance issues

-Boss Battle
There's a new and OBVIOUS indicator when the boss has a Shield On.
The boss will put on a shield less often.
The boss health has been reduced.
Enemy Pirate ships will now spawn during the boss battle.
You are not the only one who can drive plasma boats now...

Many people were having trouble with being struck by lightning all the time, basically the only way to prevent that was to hide in the tesla coil blind spot, under the dock, or by running away from the shore, but now with the voxels you can create walls and trenches while crouching to make it easier to hide.

-Grappling hook
The grappling speed is no longer affected by fps
Added new sound and particle effects, there will be a new sound when the hook has successfully attached, making it easier to know when its safe to swing around.

-Platforming
The bouncy starfish are now automatic, no more special timing required!
The platforming inside of the factory has been slightly changed.

-Cannon flight
Added some rings that will make you fly faster
You can no longer force yourself to stay floating forever.

-New and better looking 3D Models for:
Crushers
Platforms
Shrinking platforms
Boats
Fan boosters
Crates
Barrels
Bridges
Buttons
Gears
Fire
Lamps

-New furniture: (you will be able to build and place them in the future)
Doors
Windows
Tables
Chairs
Beds
Bureaus
Lamps
Wood Fences
Chain Fences

-Vegetation
New and better looking grass.
New red flowers have been added.


-Added some Bubbles when going underwater.
-Swords now have a trail effect.
-New Clouds on the mountain
-New burning effect on the character

-Skill tree items
When not aiming, the items will automatically aim forward to where the character is facing, so you don't have to move the camera all over the place if you don't want to.
Lower level distract items stun time has been increased.
Distract items now have exploding stars effect when activated.
Water items will spray water from the new dynamic water system (may remove if it interrupts a lot with the gameplay).
Crush items now have a new ground impact visual effect.

-New UI re organization, added a how to play page, (still in the works).

-And a lot of optimizations.

notes.title: update
notes.content:

-instead of pressing O to chat added a chat button to the UI.
-better chat bubble.
-Character will automatically release itself from the ladder when touching ground.
-tweaked the tree model.
-changed some of the stairs to better looking ones.

notes.title: QoL Update, More intuitive UI
notes.content:
-Fixed multiplayer pirate ship jitter
-Fixed clothing not updating after respawning
-Added yellow questionmarks around the map which you can trigger to learn how to play the game!
-Lightning flash is smoother and less flashy for the eyes.
-removed floating stairs and added better looking ones.
-Increased Boss accuracy
-Massive optimization and performance increase (less GPU load) game now runs smoothly on low end laptops.
-certain graphics settings have been removed to prevent the graphics from looking awful at low settings.
-vegetation now gets reduced at lower settings
-boat wakes are disabled for lower settings.
-slightly improved the factory interior.
-New more intuitive UI!
-items now have a different color UI depending on its category.
-New plasma cannon appearance for the boat and ship.
-Quick selection menu, now you can jump straight into the boss battle or infiltrate the facility right away.
-Tesla coils will make a charging sound before they strike.
-Stormy weather now has a stormcloudy appearance.
-Some light for plasma and explosion particles.
-changed the appearance of some items.

notes.title: New Update! Improving gameplay mechanics and character movement
notes.content:
UPDATE TIME!

-The character movement has been improved, more rotate resistant, turn faster, now you can wall jump.
-Character air movement has been increased.
-Aiming has been improved.
-Impact items have longer range and are faster.
-Crush items deal more damage.
-You can now right click repeatedly to release from the ladder.
-Pirate Rocket push has been decreased.
-Rocket Turret Rocket push and damage has been decreased.
-Rocket Turret health reduced to 200.
-Laser Turrets now rotate slower.
-Laser Turret health reduced to 300.
-Grappling hook has been made stronger, now you can swing faster and carry heavier items with it.
-Grappling hook can now be attached to enemies, characters and objects.
-Fixed some Grappling hook bugs.
-Made Grappling hook rope thin.
-Fixed some rock collisions.
-Added signs to help guide the player.
-Now you can aim your sword with WASD
